steps.say: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis is a necrotizing granulomatous vasculitis of small and medium vessels. Upper airway with lower airway and kidney are forming the classical clinical triad. Nose with lung and kidney are failing together. Three organs are inflaming as one syndrome.
steps.tx: **Granulomatosis with polyangiitis (GPA, formerly Wegener granulomatosis)** is a necrotizing **granulomatous small- and medium-vessel vasculitis**. **Upper airway** with **lower airway** and **kidney** are forming the classical clinical triad. Nose with lung and kidney are failing together. Three organs are inflaming as one syndrome.

vis.alt: GPA triad diagram with saddle nose and subglottic stenosis, c-ANCA tube, lung nodules with alveolar hemorrhage, and kidney with glomerulonephritis inset.
vis.caption: GPA triad: airway, lung and kidney around c-ANCA. Doses and trials are in the text, not on the drawing (StewardMD).

steps.say: Cytoplasmic ANCA against proteinase 3 is present in 85 to 90 percent of generalized active cases. Cell-surface proteinase 3 on primed neutrophils is grabbing the antibody. Degranulation with respiratory burst and endothelial necrosis is following the binding. Antibodies are turning neutrophils against vessels.
steps.tx: **Cytoplasmic ANCA (c-ANCA)** against **proteinase 3 (PR3-ANCA)** is present in **85 to 90 percent** of generalized active cases. Cell-surface **PR3 on primed neutrophils** is grabbing the antibody. **Degranulation** with **respiratory burst** and **endothelial necrosis** is following the binding. Antibodies are turning neutrophils against vessels.

rows: c-ANCA against proteinase 3 in 85 to 90 percent

steps.say: Upper airway disease is striking more than 90 percent of GPA patients. Chronic refractory rhinosinusitis with epistaxis and crusting is opening the course. Septal perforation is collapsing the bridge into saddle-nose deformity. Hearing loss with dangerous subglottic stenosis is threatening air and ear. Crusts today are predicting saddles tomorrow.
steps.tx: **Upper airway disease** is striking more than **90 percent** of GPA patients. Chronic refractory **rhinosinusitis** with **epistaxis** and **crusting** is opening the course. **Septal perforation** is collapsing the bridge into **saddle-nose deformity**. **Hearing loss** with dangerous **subglottic stenosis** is threatening air and ear. Crusts today are predicting saddles tomorrow.

rows: Hearing loss and dangerous subglottic stenosis

steps.say: Bilateral nodular lung lesions are scattering across both lungs. Thick irregular walls are cavitating in up to 50 percent on CT. Alveolar consolidations are filling neighboring airspaces. Diffuse alveolar hemorrhage from necrotizing capillaritis is threatening life. Nodules are cavitating while capillaries are bleeding.

Alveolar **consolidations** are filling neighboring airspaces. Diffuse **alveolar hemorrhage** from necrotizing **capillaritis** is threatening life. Nodules are cavitating while capillaries are bleeding.

rows: Bilateral, cavitating with thick irregular walls in up to 50 percent
Diffuse alveolar bleeding from necrotizing capillaritis

steps.say: Pauci-immune necrotizing crescentic glomerulonephritis is attacking the kidneys. Cellular crescents with fibrinoid necrosis are filling the urinary space. Immune deposits are staying absent on immunofluorescence. Rapid renal failure with active sediment is announcing the lesion. Crescents are growing while deposits are staying absent.
steps.tx: **Pauci-immune necrotizing crescentic glomerulonephritis** is attacking the kidneys. **Cellular crescents** with **fibrinoid necrosis** are filling the urinary space. **Immune deposits** are staying absent on **immunofluorescence**. Rapid renal failure with active sediment is announcing the lesion. Crescents are growing while deposits are staying absent.

vis.alt: Four-panel ANCA vasculitis figure with saddle nose, strawberry gingivitis, glomerular crescent, and purpuric leg lesions.
vis.caption: ANCA vasculitis signs with glomerular crescent center stage. Trial regimens are in the text, not on the drawing (StewardMD).

steps.say: The RAVE trial is establishing rituximab as induction equal to cyclophosphamide. Weekly dosing at 375 mg per meter squared for 4 doses is matching daily oral cyclophosphamide. Relapsing disease at presentation is responding significantly better to rituximab. Antibody therapy is equaling alkylators and beating them in relapse.
steps.tx: The **RAVE trial** is establishing **rituximab** as induction equal to **cyclophosphamide**. Weekly dosing at **375 mg/m2 for 4 doses** is matching **daily oral cyclophosphamide**. **Relapsing disease** at presentation is responding significantly better to rituximab. Antibody therapy is equaling alkylators and beating them in relapse.

rows: 375 mg per meter squared weekly for 4 doses

steps.say: The ADVOCATE trial is proving avacopan superior to tapering steroids. Oral dosing at 30 mg twice daily is blocking the complement C5a receptor. Sustained remission at week 52 is favoring the avacopan arm. Glucocorticoid toxicities are melting away without the steroid load. Complement blockade is outlasting steroids.
steps.tx: The **ADVOCATE trial** is proving **avacopan** superior to tapering steroids. Oral dosing at **30 mg twice daily** is blocking the **complement C5a receptor (C5aR1)**. **Sustained remission at week 52** is favoring the avacopan arm. **Glucocorticoid toxicities** are melting away without the steroid load. Complement blockade is outlasting steroids.

rows: Avacopan 30 mg twice daily, oral C5a receptor blocker
Superior sustained remission at week 52 with fewer steroid toxicities

steps.say: Maintenance therapy is belonging to rituximab as the standard of care. Dosing at 500 mg every 6 months for 18 to 24 months is beating azathioprine in MAINRITSAN. Pneumocystis prophylaxis with trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole is mandated for rituximab or cyclophosphamide courses. Rituximab is maintaining while sulfa is protecting lungs.
